description:
An operator runs selected cold and snapshot flows concurrently with a bounded worker count and receives every result, including failures and refused cleanup.

## Scope

* In: worker selection, scheduling, atomic capacity admission, per-worker state isolation, interruption handling, and aggregate completion.
* Out: new lanes or product scenarios, nightly scheduling, pull-request selection, and feature delivery gates.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Invalid worker counts are refused before mutation, and the running set never exceeds the requested worker count or the host VM budget when cold, snapshot, and variable-size recipes overlap with other live topologies. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Unit/E2E/ScenarioSchedulerTest.php` and Incus harness acceptance `scenario-worker-capacity`.
- [ ] Concurrent scenarios share no mutable checkout, state root, network, guest, or database; creation admission is atomic, while guest preparation and exercise can overlap. Proof: Incus harness acceptance `scenario-worker-isolation`.
- [ ] A product failure or cleanup refusal in one worker does not cancel unrelated runnable flows; the aggregate includes every selected flow and both primary and cleanup outcomes before returning its final exit code. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Unit/E2E/ScenarioSchedulerTest.php`.
- [ ] On interruption, active workers attempt cleanup of their recorded resources and retain actionable recovery state; unstarted flows are reported explicitly, and an unrelated topology survives. Proof: Incus harness acceptance `scenario-worker-interruption`.
- [ ] Maintained guidance states worker and capacity behavior, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Harness checks pass. Proof: `cd apps/e2e && composer check`.
title: Run independent scenarios within a bounded worker budget
